decline an offer: She politely declined an offer to work abroad because she wanted to stay close to her family.
她禮貌地婉拒了到國外工作的提議，因為她想待在家人身邊。
sales declined: After the bad news about its safety problems, sales declined sharply and the store had to cut prices.
在安全問題的負面消息之後，銷售急劇下滑，店家只好降價。
health declines: As people grow older, their health declines, so regular exercise and a good diet become more important.
隨著人們年紀漸長，健康衰退，所以規律運動和良好飲食變得更加重要。
decline to comment: When reporters asked about the scandal, the mayor declined to comment and quickly got into his car.
當記者問起醜聞時，市長拒絕評論，並迅速坐進他的車。
a declining population: The village faces a declining population because most young people move to big cities to find jobs.
這個村莊面臨人口減少，因為大部分年輕人搬到大城市找工作。
be decorated for bravery: The firefighter was decorated for bravery after he saved two children from a burning building.
這位消防員從失火的大樓中救出兩名孩童後，因英勇獲頒勳章。
decorate the room: We used balloons and colorful lights to decorate the room for my sister's birthday party.
我們用氣球和彩色燈飾來布置房間，為妹妹的生日派對做準備。
dedicate one's life to: Mother Teresa chose to dedicate her life to helping the poor and the sick in India.
德蕾莎修女選擇奉獻一生於幫助印度的窮人和病人。
dedicate a book to: The author decided to dedicate a book to her late father, who first taught her to love reading.
作者決定把書獻給她已故的父親，是他最先教會她熱愛閱讀。
a dedicated teacher: A dedicated teacher like Ms. Lin stays after school every day to help students who are struggling.
像林老師這樣盡責的老師，每天放學後都會留下來幫助學習有困難的學生。
dedicate time: If you really want to learn the guitar, you need to dedicate time to practicing every single day.
如果你真的想學吉他，你需要每天投入時間練習。
defeat the purpose: Taking the elevator up to the gym kind of defeats the purpose of going there to exercise.
搭電梯上樓去健身房，有點違背了去那裡運動的本意。
defeat the enemy: The general came up with a clever plan to defeat the enemy without losing many of his soldiers.
將軍想出一個聰明的計畫，在不損失太多士兵的情況下擊敗敵人。
admit defeat: After trying to fix the computer for three hours, he finally had to admit defeat and call an expert.
花了三小時試著修電腦後，他終於不得不認輸，打電話找專家。
defeat a proposal: The city council voted to defeat a proposal for a new parking lot, so the park will stay as it is.
市議會投票否決了新建停車場的提案，所以公園會維持原樣。
defend one's title: Last year's champion will defend her title at the tennis tournament in Taipei next month.
去年的冠軍將於下個月在台北的網球錦標賽中衛冕。
defend a thesis: Before he can graduate, the student must defend a thesis in front of three professors.
在畢業之前，這名學生必須在三位教授面前進行論文口試答辯。
defend one's rights: Workers joined together to defend their rights when the company tried to cut their pay unfairly.
當公司試圖不公平地減薪時，工人們團結起來捍衛他們的權利。
defend a decision: The principal had to defend a decision to cancel the school trip when many angry parents complained.
當許多憤怒的家長抱怨時，校長必須為取消校外教學的決定辯護。
defend the goal: Our best player was asked to defend the goal because the usual goalkeeper was sick.
我們最好的球員被要求守門，因為平常的守門員生病了。
defy gravity: The dancers seemed to defy gravity as they jumped high into the air and floated across the stage.
舞者們高高躍起、在舞台上飄過，彷彿違抗了地心引力。
defy description: The view from the top of Jade Mountain at sunrise was so beautiful that it seemed to defy description.
日出時從玉山山頂看到的景色美到難以形容。
defy orders: The soldier chose to defy orders because he refused to fire at peaceful protesters.
這名士兵選擇抗命，因為他拒絕向和平的抗議者開槍。
defy expectations: Nobody thought the small team could win, but they defied expectations and reached the final.
沒有人認為這支小隊伍能贏，但他們出乎預料地打進了決賽。
defy the law: Drivers who defy the law by using their phones while driving put everyone on the road in danger.
藐視法律、開車時使用手機的駕駛人會讓路上每個人都陷入危險。
delegate tasks: A good leader knows how to delegate tasks to team members instead of trying to do everything alone.
好的領導者懂得把任務分派給團隊成員，而不是試圖一個人做所有事。
delegate authority: As the company grew, the owner had to delegate authority to managers so decisions could be made faster.
隨著公司成長，老闆必須把權力下放給經理們，好讓決策能更快做出。
delegate responsibility: Busy parents sometimes delegate responsibility for simple chores, like washing dishes, to their older children.
忙碌的父母有時會把洗碗之類的簡單家事責任委派給年紀較大的孩子。
